business_summary: Kyokuto Boeki Kaisha, Ltd. primarily operates as an engineering trading company in Japan and internationally. The company operates through Industrial equipment related department, Industrial materials related department, and Machine parts related department segments. It is involved in the import, export, wholesale, sale, and agent services related to machinery, equipment, materials, measuring instruments, gauges, vessels, vehicles, hardware, chemical engineering products, explosives, foodstuffs, textiles and textile products, pharmaceuticals, medical devices, and other general merchandise; aircrafts; space appliances and parts; computers and parts; power generation facilities, control devices, and monitoring devices and parts; bridges; boilers; turbines; communication systems; pollution control devices, such as water treatment devices and atmospheric contamination analyzer; devices related to natural resource exploration, analysis and excavation, and parts; alcoholic beverages and drinking water; agrochemicals, herbicides, feeds, feed additives, fertilizers, and fertilizer additives and related materials; and fuel, medical supplies, fuel cells, and related materials. The company also provides repair and maintenance services related to the machinery, devices, and facilities; engages in acquisition, planning, licensing, sale, repair, maintenance, and brokering of computer system technology and software; and computer-based information processing and provision, and advertising activities. In addition, it offers general leasing, transportation, construction contracting, temporary staffing, life insurance, and non-life insurance agency services. Kyokuto Boeki Kaisha, Ltd. was incorporated in 1947 and is headquartered in Chiyoda, Japan.
